runs.text: Britain, judged like Israel. Ready? Official report. Finding one: Britain is stolen land. The Angles and Saxons moved in around the year four hundred and fifty. England literally means land of the Angles. So, decolonize Britain! Give it back to the Britons! Wait. Before the Britons, someone else built Stonehenge. Finding two: occupation. Britain holds the Falklands, twelve thousand seven hundred kilometres from London. The islanders voted to stay British. Doesn't matter. Occupation! Finding three: walls. Belfast still has dozens of peace walls. Finding four: in nineteen eighty two, Argentina lost six hundred and forty nine people. Britain lost two hundred and fifty five. Disproportionate! Finding five: rain, almost every day. Collective punishment. Sounds ridiculous? Israel hears it every day. Britain isn't an apartheid state. Neither is Israel, where one in five citizens is Arab. Both have real problems. One standard. So, one more time.
